description.p: A desktop client for OpenLinkHub, the open source Linux service for Corsair devices. It gives OpenLinkHub an iCUE-style interface: device artwork with clickable buttons, an action list and a settings panel. The client only talks to OpenLinkHub's HTTP API; OpenLinkHub must be running.

ul.li: Key remapping for mice, headsets, controllers and keyboards
Keyboards drawn from the key layout OpenLinkHub sends
DPI stages, lighting, fans and pumps, equalizer and device settings
OpenLinkHub user profiles and the Slipstream receiver
Login for OpenLinkHub instances with dashboard authentication

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Corsair.

ul.li: Gigabyte graphics cards with RGB Fusion 2 lighting (AORUS, GAMING OC, EAGLE and others, GeForce and Radeon), driven by the app itself over I2C (OpenLinkHub Client Plus and OpenDeviceHub)
Graphics cards: nine lighting modes, brightness, speed and a colour per zone; "Save to card" keeps the lighting after a power cycle

description.p: Released as three apps from now on: OpenLinkHub Client (Corsair devices through OpenLinkHub), OpenLinkHub Client Plus (Corsair devices and non-Corsair devices) and OpenDeviceHub (non-Corsair devices only, no OpenLinkHub needed).

ul.li: Non-Corsair devices, driven by the app itself: Keychron V3 Ultra 8K keyboards (ANSI, ISO, JIS), by cable or the Ultra-Link 8K receiver (OpenLinkHub Client Plus and OpenDeviceHub)
Keychron: remap every key and the knob on each layer, lighting effect, brightness, speed and colour, USB and 2.4 GHz polling rate, debounce and the idle and sleep timers
Each app updates itself to its own bundle
Macros tab: create, edit and delete macros of keys, mouse buttons, delays, text and mouse moves, and reorder their actions
Saving a macro closes gaps in its actions that kept the later actions from playing
New macros show up in Key remapping without selecting the device again
Battery levels in the tray menu and tooltip, with a notification when a battery runs low
Show the app icon in the application menu right after installing (KDE Plasma)
GitHub releases now carry these release notes

description.p: First release, as a Flatpak with built-in updates.
